material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Oct 22, 2024 to Jan 15 (+214%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−7.3% to −26%), with the Oct 9, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−49%); a close over the wave-1 high (+60%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 7 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+8.3% to −0.7%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−28%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.
